F1.title: IMPACT: color flood (169.40-172.96)
F1.idea: At the impact a wave of colour bursts from her and sweeps the engraved skyline; she sprints out of it at camera. Built as a radial matte wipe (tools/sectionF/wipe.py) between the engraved twin of the clip (tools/engrave, strength 1, no bloom) and the colour clip, with a hatched pencil-stroke front and a gold leading edge. The wipe matte is kept as take_N_wipe_matte.mp4.

takes.1: half-bloom keyframe: she jogs rather than sprints and the 'after' is still mostly gray buildings, so the flood reads weakly. Fallback.
takes.3: full-colour keyframe (colored girders and facades) so the before/after is unmistakable.

F1.judgement: The wipe itself works: the engraved twin is a convincing Escher plate of the same frame and the colour arrives from her. The engrave matte leaks some wave colour around her in the engraved twin; it reads as the colour starting at her, so it stays. Take 3 (full-colour keyframe) is in the cut: wipe origin on her, outq ease, the front reaches the corners on the bar-98 downbeat.

F2.title: Wall-run up the Willis Tower (172.96-176.48)
F2.idea: She runs up the tower face with two ghosts flanking (magenta, emerald), dragging a pencil line. Bar 100 is a 1.18x punch-in on the same take. 'never stop' (175.59) written in pale pencil on the glass.

takes.1: Seedance turned the vertical facade into a tilted floor after ~1.5 s. Rejected for take 2.
takes.2: true wall-run: they sprint up the facade away from camera, reach the top and launch off it. Used (0-1.76 for bar 99, 3.24-5.0 for bar 100).

F2.judgement: Take 2 is a clean wall-run with the ghosts in step and the pencil line on the glass; bar 100 jumps to the top-of-tower launch.

F3.title: Relativity flip (176.48-180.02)
F3.idea: Escher's Relativity hall in colour; she runs upside down on the underside of a staircase, agents (still pure black ink) tumble off. The engine snaps a 90-degree roll + zoom on the downbeat; Seedance adds a continuous roll.

takes.1: good: continuous camera roll, agents falling, Jade on-model. Used.

F3.judgement: One of the strongest shots. Paper margin cropped (5.6%).

F4.title: Bean dive (180.02-183.56)
F4.idea: She dives head-first at Cloud Gate; her colour reflection rushes up; she hits the mirror on 183.56 (white flash into the boss).

takes.1: first 2 s good, then Seedance cut to a photographic street and a face close-up with a hand over the face: rejected after 2.0 s.
takes.2: dive, hands touch her reflection at ~3 s, she plunges into concentric ripples and vanishes by 5 s. Used at 1.3x.

F4.judgement: Take 2 is exactly the inverse-of-S2 beat: the mirror becomes liquid and takes her into the boss fight on 183.56.

F5a.title: HERO: the boss (183.56-187.08)
F5a.idea: Swell 183.72: airborne, a giant pencil drawn back like a sword, the colossal melting clock over the Loop dripping agents.

takes.1: great: slow push-in, she winds the pencil back, clock drips. Used.

F5a.judgement: The pencil is oversized (anime sword exaggeration); deliberate. Clock face has dash ticks only, no numerals.

F5b.title: The clock drips agents (187.08-190.58)
F5b.idea: Deliberate wide at golden hour: ink drips turn into black-suited agents falling onto the rooftops; Jade small on a water-tower roof. Swell 189.54 gets a warm flash.

takes.1: good drips and falling agents; the camera drifts right and crops Jade after ~3 s. Used 0-3.5 s.

F5b.judgement: Reads. Jade is small by design (the one deliberate wide).

F6a.title: The loop gesture (190.58-194.10)
F6a.idea: She sweeps the pencil in a circle; a gold line encircles the clock; the camera orbits with her arm.

takes.1: the gold line draws several loops rather than one, the camera swings round. Used.

F6a.judgement: Good energy; 'a single loop' became several, acceptable.

F6b.title: Clock hands = Penrose stairs (194.10-195.86)
F6b.idea: The clock face's hands have become Ascending and Descending; agents march it forever. Reused at F7_03.

F6c.title: Super Meat Boy replay (195.86-197.60)
F6c.idea: Side-on sprint with a stream of colour ghost Jades running in step behind her (Super Meat Boy replay). 'never stop' (196.68) in pencil on the ground strip.

takes.1: clean side-on sprint, but the engine ghost layer over it (her matte carries background) read as smeared afterimages. Replaced; take 1 lives on reversed as F7_08 (the rewind that paints).
takes.2: new keyframe kf_ghosts2 with the ghost stream drawn in: crisp colour ghosts in step behind her. Used (0.3-2.04 s).

F6c.judgement: Take 2 replaces the engine-ghost version; the ghosts are drawn by nano and animated by Seedance, crisp and on-model.

F7a.title: Ghost stampede (197.60-198.48, reused 202.88)
F7a.idea: A stampede of translucent colour ghosts of her, real Jade leading.

takes.1: good; the pencil leaves her hand after frame 0 (not visible in 0.9 s). Used.

F7c.title: BIG 1: Klimt gold (200.24-202.02)
F7c.idea: Swell 200.25: she soars through a gold-leaf mosaic sky; the camera rises with her.

F7d.title: The clock folds into itself (202.02-202.88, tail at 207.28)
F7d.idea: The melting clock twists into a Moebius loop and collapses to a gold point.

takes.1: excellent: collapse to a star at ~3.2 s. Used.

F7e.title: BIG 2: Banach-Tarski reunion (203.76-205.52)
F7e.idea: Swell 203.78: two Jades leap together and merge into one in a burst of motes and gold flakes.

takes.1: merge at ~0.8 s, one Jade lands. Used.

F8.title: The committee (209.90-211.64)
F8.idea: She stops center frame, breathing; ghost Jades in a line behind her. 'never stop' (210.77) in pencil in the sky. Band out 210.90.

O2.title: Dawn: the defense (218.92-222.78)
O2.idea: Dawn hallway; she twists her hair up and pushes the pencil back in (New Game+), opens the door and walks in. A paper notice 'DISSERTATION DEFENSE / 9:00 AM' is corner-pinned on the door under the blank brass plaque (hand-keyed track in tools/sectionF/o2_plaque.json). Played at 1.3x so the door opens before the hard cut at 222.78.

takes.1: hair-up + pencil at 2.4-3.6 s, door opens ~4.6 s. Used.

F6b_3d.title: (3D) the clock's hands close into Penrose stairs (192.34-195.86)
F6b_3d.idea: section E's render/three/scenes/f6_clock.js, offered to F: camera keeps turning with her gesture, clunks into the magic angle on 194.10.
